ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolios
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by their one-month forward discounts, then hold a long position in the highest-interest-rate portfolio and a short position in the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.

rules.market: Currency forwards against USD; the paper also studies a developed-country sample that includes major currencies.
rules.entry: At month end, sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount. Go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
rules.exit: Rebalance at the end of every month.

not_stated: results restricted exclusively to FX major currencies
ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports an annualized Sharpe ratio of 0.32 for the long-short strategy in its developed-country sample, using data from November 1983 through December 2009.
